fields.protocol_layer: OSI level 7 (application). Wire signaling delegated to the chosen transport.

channels_pdu.name: FUNCTION_CODE
channels_pdu.purpose: Identifies the action requested. Range 1..255 (0 invalid; 128..255 = exception).

channels_pdu.name: DATA
channels_pdu.purpose: Function-code-dependent data field — addresses, quantities, byte count, register values, coil states.

channels_modbus_rtu_adu.name: CRC
channels_modbus_rtu_adu.purpose: CRC-16-Modbus (poly 0xA001 reflected, init 0xFFFF). Low byte first on the wire.

channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.name: TRANSACTION_ID
channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.purpose: Request/response correlation across pipelined transactions on a single TCP socket.

channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.name: LENGTH
channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.purpose: Number of following bytes = 1 (Unit ID) + len(PDU).

channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.name: UNIT_ID
channels_modbus_tcp_mbap.purpose: Server address on a sub-network behind a gateway; 0xFF / 0x00 when the TCP endpoint is the MODBUS server.

global_signals.name: BUS_IDLE_STATE
global_signals.purpose: Serial line idle = UART mark (HIGH). T3.5 silence before/after every RTU frame.

global_signals.name: TCP_PORT_502
global_signals.purpose: IANA-reserved server port for MODBUS TCP.

global_signals.name: BIG_ENDIAN_ORDER
global_signals.purpose: All multi-byte numerical quantities are MSB-first on the wire.

dependency_graph.common_rule: MODBUS is strictly request/reply: the client transmits a complete request ADU; the server validates, executes, and responds (or stays silent on broadcast / framing error). There is no application-layer ACK separate from the response PDU.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: The Data field of the response depends on the Data field of the request (Starting Address, Quantity, etc.) and on the server's data-table contents. The MBAP.Transaction_ID of the response equals that of the request.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering: Big-endian (MSB first) for all multi-byte numerical quantities in the PDU.
ordering_rules.rtu_crc_order: CRC-16 result is transmitted low byte first, then high byte — exception to the big-endian rule.
ordering_rules.ascii_nibble_order: Within each 2-ASCII-hex byte encoding, the high nibble is the first character sent.
ordering_rules.frame_ordering_serial: Order on the wire: Address, Function Code, Data (per FC layout), then CRC (RTU) or LRC (ASCII). For ASCII the entire frame is bracketed by ':' and CR LF.
ordering_rules.frame_ordering_tcp: Order on the wire: Transaction ID Hi, Transaction ID Lo, Protocol ID Hi, Protocol ID Lo, Length Hi, Length Lo, Unit ID, Function Code, Data.
